#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

const int MOD = 998244353;

std::vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const std::vector<int>& p1, const std::vector<int>& p2, int mod) {
    int requiredLength = p1.size() + p2.size() - 1;
    int fftSize = 1;
    while (fftSize < requiredLength) fftSize <<= 1;

    std::vector<double> pr1(fftSize, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> pi1(fftSize, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> pr2(fftSize, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> pi2(fftSize, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)p1.size(); i++) {
        long long val = p1[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        pr1[i] = val & 0x7fffLL;
        pi1[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)p2.size(); i++) {
        long long val = p2[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        pr2[i] = val & 0x7fffLL;
        pi2[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    // Perform FFT
    auto performFFT = [](std::vector<double>& real, std::vector<double>& imag, bool inverse) {
        int n = real.size();
        int logN = 0;
        int temp = n;
        while (temp > 1) {
            logN++;
            temp >>= 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int rev = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < logN; j++) {
                if (i & (1 << j)) {
                    rev |= 1 << (logN - 1 - j);
                }
            }
            if (i < rev) {
                std::swap(real[i], real[rev]);
                std::swap(imag[i], imag[rev]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            double cosStep = cos(angle);
            double sinStep = sin(angle);

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double cos = 1.0;
                double sin = 0.0;

                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double uReal = real[i + j];
                    double uImag = imag[i + j];
                    double vReal = real[i + j + half] * cos - imag[i + j + half] * sin;
                    double vImag = real[i + j + half] * sin + imag[i + j + half] * cos;

                    real[i + j] = uReal + vReal;
                    imag[i + j] = uImag + vImag;
                    real[i + j + half] = uReal - vReal;
                    imag[i + j + half] = uImag - vImag;

                    double newCos = cos * cosStep - sin * sinStep;
                    sin = cos * sinStep + sin * cosStep;
                    cos = newCos;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] /= n;
                imag[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };

    performFFT(pr1, pi1, false);
    performFFT(pr2, pi2, false);

    std::vector<double> resRe(fftSize, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> resIm(fftSize, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
        int j = (fftSize - i) & (fftSize - 1);
        double a1r = (pr1[i] + pr1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (pi1[i] - pi1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (pi1[i] + pi1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (pr1[j] - pr1[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (pr2[i] + pr2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (pi2[i] - pi2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (pi2[i] + pi2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (pr2[j] - pr2[i]) * 0.5;

        resRe[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resIm[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
    }

    performFFT(resRe, resIm, true);

    std::vector<int> result(requiredLength);
    for (int i = 0; i < requiredLength; i++) {
        long long realPart = llround(resRe[i]);
        long long imagPart = llround(resIm[i]);
        long long combined = (realPart + (imagPart << 15)) % mod;
        result[i] = (int)combined;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;

    std::vector<int> basePoly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        std::cin >> idx;
        basePoly[idx] = 1;
    }

    std::vector<int> result = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;

    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = multiplyPolynomials(result, basePoly, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        basePoly = multiplyPolynomials(basePoly, basePoly, MOD);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int coef : result) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)coef * coef) % MOD;
    }
    std::cout << answer << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
